ModMetaData.name: LargePawns Pathfinding Guard 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Compatibility/performance guard for RimWorld 1.5 Large Pawns + Pathfinding Framework. It does not replace normal pathfinding. It watches only non-player large pawns (BodySize >= 2) already executing edge/ExitMap Goto jobs. After repeated slow/failing path attempts it throttles expensive StartPath/TryEnterNextPathCell retries; if an NPC is already within 64 cells of the map edge and repeatedly proves unable to exit, it completes the already-requested exit as a narrow fail-safe. Normal pawn paths, player pawns and non-exit jobs are untouched.
